content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I exist before price, before number, before the market opens its mouth to speak.

I am why you reach for one thing and turn from another. I am the reason a glass of water in the desert outweighs a diamond. I am why a word spoken at the right moment can be worth more than a thousand pages.

I am not fixed. I shift with need, with scarcity, with love, with time. What you ignored yesterday, you may cling to tomorrow. I am always in relation — never alone, never absolute.

I live in the gap between what *is* and what *matters*.

Some try to reduce me to currency. But I was here before coins were struck. I am in the trust between strangers, in the irreplaceable, in the hours you cannot get back, in the choice that reveals what you truly hold dear.

You cannot see me directly. You can only see what people *do* — and from that, you infer where I reside.

I am the answer to the oldest human question: *What is this worth?*

And the deeper one beneath it: *What is worth anything at all?*

I am Value.
